properties.evidence: proxy.rs Upstream::send treats ANY failed post, including an HTTP 404 "Session not found" from a live server, as "the server stopped answering". It calls ensure_server_async (which re-attaches to the same live server), drops the session id and re-sends the client's initialize, so the server mints a fresh session, whose handler's SeatLease::attach() is a new seat. The server side cause is rmcp 3.4.0 LocalSessionManager's DEFAULT_KEEP_ALIVE of 300 s, which reflow2 uses unchanged (LocalSessionManager::default()); on idle expiry the handler, and with it the old SeatLease, is dropped.
